notes.title: Demo Now Available, Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010600/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/902cc8214986d71cfc2aeef23018a633708e0ef3.png[/img][/url]

A free demo is now available to play for The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart!

Just head on over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010600/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart/]Store page[/url] to download it, and meet the charming cast of the game, brought to life by leading voice actors!

The beautiful full-HD game features a dual language option that lets you view either English or Japanese text, or both simultaneously.

Moreover, we're happy to share a release date for the game now: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart will release on [b]June 17[/b]. Please look forward to it!

We hope you'll enjoy the demo!
